main.description: A forum's stamps: the admin-defined stamp records plus the generated network set. With actor, also that member's tray (every stamp they hold on this forum) and the ids they currently wear, in order.

actor.description: A member whose tray and worn list to include.

stamps.description: Stamps the forum defined, as app.atmobb.forum.stamp records.

network.description: The fixed network stamps every forum on this appview offers (first light, early days). Board and arrival defaults are per member and appear in the tray.

tray.description: Every stamp the actor holds on this forum. Present only when actor is given.

worn.description: Ids from the tray the actor wears, in order. Present only when actor is given.

stampView.description: An admin-defined stamp. uri and cid let a by-hand award build its strongRef.

generatedStamp.description: A stamp the network generates rather than an admin defining. Its id is fixed: atmobb:board:<board at-uri>, atmobb:arrival, atmobb:first-light, or atmobb:early-days.

board.description: For a board stamp: the board it marks.

sponsor.description: For an arrival stamp: who brought the member in.

via.description: For an arrival stamp: how the member was accepted.

trayEntry.description: One stamp a member holds. id is the stamp record's at-uri for an admin stamp or the fixed id of a generated one. uri, cid, and look are present for admin stamps and look for network stamps; a board default carries the board and its color so the app can draw it, and an arrival default carries via and sponsor.

board.description: For a board stamp: the board it marks.

boardColor.description: For a board stamp: the board's six-digit hex color, when it has one.

sponsor.description: For an arrival stamp: who brought the member in.

via.description: For an arrival stamp: how the member was accepted.

source.description: How the member came to hold it: an admin-defined trigger, a default every member gets, the network set, or a by-hand award.
